description: Fetch npm download counts for a package over a named period (last-day, last-week, last-month, last-year) or a custom date range like "2024-01-01:2024-06-30". Returns total downloads, start date, and end date.

period.description: Download period: last-day, last-week (default), last-month, or a date range like 2024-01-01:2024-06-30

name: get_downloads
